thanksgivukkah.definition:
Thanksgivukkah is the name given to the convergence of the American holiday of Thanksgiving and the first day of Hanukkah on November 28, 2013. It is a result of a rare kink between the lunar Hebrew calendar and the Gregorian calendar. According to nuclear physicist Jonathan Mizrahi, the overlap only occurs once every 80,000 years.\r
The phrase was coined by Boston-area resident Dana Gitell. Gitell, along with her sister-in-law Deborah Gitell, created a Facebook page and Twitter account devoted to the phenomenon. A Los Angeles-based festival will be held on November 29, 2013 at the Pico Union Building.\r
Thanksgivukkah is characterized by products promoted on and sold online. Funds to produce a turkey-shaped menorah, dubbed "a menurkey" were raised via a Kickstarter campaign. The Los Angeles Thanksgivukkah festival is being funded by a campaign on Jewcer.\r
While the imagery and products surrounding the day are light-hearted, advocates contend it has a broader significance resonant with American democracy. "There are amazing similarities between the Pilgrims’ quest for religious freedom and what the Maccabees were fighting for,” one organizer told the New York Daily News.“This a great opportunity for Jewish Americans to celebrate this country and for everyone to acknowledge the greatness of our shared religious freedoms.”
> Combined holiday of Thanksgiving and the first day of Hanukkah, hence "Thanksgivukkah," on November 28th, 2013. Resulting from the rare kink between the lunar Hebrew calendar and the Gregorian calendar which occurs every 80,000 years!

that.definition:
pron., a., conj., &  As a demonstrative pronoun (pl. Those),
   that usually points out, or refers to, a person or thing previously
   mentioned, or supposed to be understood. That, as a demonstrative, may
   precede the noun to which it refers; as, that which he has said is
   true; those in the basket are good apples.
pron., a., conj., &  As an adjective, that has the same
   demonstrative force as the pronoun, but is followed by a noun.
pron., a., conj., &  As a relative pronoun, that is
   equivalent to who or which, serving to point out, and make definite, a
   person or thing spoken of, or alluded to, before, and may be either
   singular or plural.
pron., a., conj., &  As a conjunction, that retains much of
   its force as a demonstrative pronoun.
pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a clause employed as the
   object of the preceding verb, or as the subject or predicate nominative
   of a verb.
pron., a., conj., &  To introduce, a reason or cause; --
   equivalent to for that, in that, for the reason that, because.
pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a purpose; -- usually
   followed by may, or might, and frequently preceded by so, in order, to
   the end, etc.
pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a consequence, result, or
   effect; -- usually preceded by so or such, sometimes by that.
pron., a., conj., &  In an elliptical sentence to introduce
   a dependent sentence expressing a wish, or a cause of surprise,
   indignation, or the like.
pron., a., conj., &  As adverb: To such a degree; so; as, he
   was that frightened he could say nothing.

thatchs.definition:
n. hair resembling thatched roofing material
n. plant stalks used as roofing material
n. a house roof made with a plant material (as straw)
v. cover with thatch
thatchs.translation:
n. 盖屋顶的茅草, 用草盖的屋顶, 浓密头发
vt. 用茅草覆盖

thatchy.translation: a. 茅屋顶的, 象茅屋顶的

thaumatology.translation: n. 奇迹学, 奇迹论

thaumatrope.definition:
n. An optical instrument or toy for showing the
   presistence of an impression upon the eyes after the luminous object is
   withdrawn.
thaumatrope.translation: n. 幻影转盘, 西洋镜

thaumatropy.translation: [医] 器官转化, 结构转化

thaumaturge.definition: n one who practices magic or sorcery
thaumaturge.translation: n. 行奇迹者, 术士

thaumaturgic.translation:
a. 魔术的, 奇术的
[医] 变幻的, 奇异的

thaumaturgical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to thaumaturgy; magical;
   wonderful.
thaumaturgical.translation: a. 奇术的, 魔术的

thaumaturgics.definition: n. Feats of legerdemain, or magical performances.
thaumaturgics.translation: a. 奇迹的；魔术的；奇术的；能变魔术的;有奇术的[亦作 thaumaturgical ／-kəl／]

thaumaturgist.definition: n one who practices magic or sorcery
thaumaturgist.translation: n. 演奇术者, 魔术师

thaumaturgy.definition:
n any art that invokes supernatural powers
n an illusory feat; considered magical by naive observers

thaw.definition:
n. the process whereby heat changes something from a solid to a liquid
n. warm weather following a freeze; snow and ice melt
n. a relaxation or slackening of tensions or reserve; becoming less hostile
thaw.translation:
n. 融解, 融化, 解冻时期
vt. 使融解, 使缓和
vi. 融化, 解冻

thaw sb.translation: 使某人的态度缓和下来

thawed.definition:
s. no longer frozen solid
s. no longer frozen
thawed.translation: v. （气候）解冻( thaw的过去式和过去分词 ); （态度、感情等）缓和; （冰、雪及冷冻食物）溶化; 软化

thawing.definition:
n the process whereby heat changes something from a solid to a liquid
n warm weather following a freeze; snow and ice melt
v become or cause to become soft or liquid

thawless.translation: a. 不融化的, 永不融化的

thaws.definition:
n the process whereby heat changes something from a solid to a liquid
n warm weather following a freeze; snow and ice melt
n a relaxation or slackening of tensions or reserve; becoming less hostile
v become or cause to become soft or liquid
thaws.translation:
n. （足以解冻的）暖和天气( thaw的名词复数 ); （敌对国家之间）关系缓和
v. （气候）解冻( thaw的第三人称单数 ); （态度、感情等）缓和; （冰、雪及冷冻食物）溶化; 软化

thawy.definition:
a. Liquefying by heat after having been frozen; thawing;
   melting.
thawy.translation: a. 解冻的, 融化的

thaxton.translation: [人名] 撒克斯顿; [地名] [美国] 萨克斯顿

thay.translation: n. 塞尔（《被遗忘的国度战役设定集》中的城市名）

thayed.translation: (thay 的过去时) n. 塞尔（《被遗忘的国度战役设定集》中的城市名）

thayer.translation: n. 金缕梅；泰勒；赛耶（人名）

thayer-doisy unit.translation: [医] 塞-道二氏单位(维生素K单位)

thayne.translation: [人名] [苏格兰人、英格兰人姓氏] 塞恩 Thain的变体
